positions.title: Telecommunications and Network engineer
positions.description:
• Serving as a Telecommunication and Network Engineer
• Supporting a Juniper Switch environment, Juniper Firewalled Environment, and the Avaya Aura 6.2 Platform  
• Managing the IP and Vlan configuration for all new server builds
• Troubleshooting layer 2 and 3 issues for IMP’s internal network
• Redesigngin a layer three Juniper Ex series switch for an office move in Peoria, IL.
I• mplementing a firewall change policy procedure with proper documentation 
Increasing security through the use of 802.1x protocols to lock down IMP’s local LAN
• Deploying IPSEC VPNs that are policy based and route based for new customers to send HL-7 and DICOM images to IMP internal servers 
• Collaborating with AT&T Engineers to set up IP Flex Toll Free routing to be load balanced between two endpoints
• Onboarding a remote offshore call center by using VPN and soft phone Avaya technologies.  
• Restructuring OSPF to have summary routes and areas 
• Managing the implementation of a IVR appliance called eIVR which uses SIP messaging to communicate with the Avaya Aura Platform
• Analyzing current infrastructure and modifying it to become more HIPPA Compliant
• Adding firewall policies and static NAT so that users can reach a remote management tool, Kaseya when not connected to our network using a VPN.  
• Adding LLDP network addresses in Juniper EX4200 Switches to remote management purposes
• Creating Windows GPOs for HIPAA security purposes.
• Establishing and updating firewall policies for our Exchange and Kaseya servers to have access to remote users

positions.title: Telecommunication Analyst (Communication Services)
positions.description:
• Served as a Telecommunications Analyst, Project Manager, and Systems Designer
• Configured new store phone systems including call routing, 50+ handsets, and basic Adtran 
 setup while on the CarMax GO Team
• Acted as a project manager for Telecommunications for new store locations
• Integrated new solutions for Loss Prevention servers to improve efficiency
• Conducted Avaya 8400 Series phone system administration through support and engineering
• Compiled documentation on the Adtran Media Gateway for the CarMax Support Teams
• Collaborated with Verizon Business Engineers to improve on inefficiencies in the Adtran Media 
 Gateways
• Designed a Call Center setup for the CarMax Payroll Services Team with log-ins, 
 hunt groups, vectors, VDNs, and reporting.
• Maintained a Microsoft 2008 Server for the Interactive Intelligence Call Center Software
• Managed the VoIP platform Interactive Intelligence CIC 4.0

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
• Interned as a Business Analyst, Project Manager, and Systems Designer in 
     Technology Integration 
• Led a team of technical analysts to construct an internal directory website in PHP for
     customer service representatives to lessen the time on the phone by reducing inefficiencies 
• Integrated multiple directories into MySQL Server Database
• Completed a Business Requirements Document analyzing risk, scalability, and the 
     increased possible throughput of each customer service representative

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:

• Organized documentation for a new PHP add-on to run credit card applications
